resources.string: Lend system powers
Lend the shell to other apps (Shizuku)
Apps made for Shizuku work without installing it. Each app asks on the TV, with the PIN, the first time.
Off
When an app needs it
Always on
The Shizuku app is installed on this TV, so the launcher stays out of its way. Uninstall it to use the launcher\'s.
Part of the paid plans.
Deny
Allow always
Allow %1$s to use the launcher\'s system powers?
The app will be able to do what adb does: install and remove apps, change system settings and more. Only allow apps you trust. You can revoke it later in the web panel.
Panel PIN to allow
Set the panel PIN first (Settings, Web panel).
Lend owner control to other apps (Dhizuku)
Apps made for Dhizuku use the launcher\'s owner control. Each app asks on the TV, with the PIN. With “Allow”, none can remove the launcher as owner or wipe the TV; with “Full power”, it can.
On
The launcher is not the owner (Device Owner) of this TV, so there is nothing to lend.
Allow %1$s to use the launcher\'s owner control?

With “Allow”, the app can hide and block apps and change the TV\'s permissions and rules, but never remove the launcher as owner or wipe the TV. “Full power” lets the app run as the launcher and read its data: only for apps you fully trust. You can revoke it in the web panel. With “Full power” the app can do anything the launcher can, even wipe the TV.
Full power
FULL POWER: the app can do anything the launcher can, even wipe the TV. Panel PIN
